notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 1 damage to Snapping Sailback.
Snapping Sailback triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Snapping Sailback trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servo tokens.
